'''Dan Starkey''' (born [[27 September (people)|27 September]] [[1977 (people)|1977]]<ref>[https://www.famousbirthdays.com/people/dan-starkey.html Famous Birthdays]</ref>) played various [[Sontaran]] roles in televised ''[[Doctor Who]]'', as well as for audio dramas and the ''Doctor Who'' video game ''[[The Gunpowder Plot (video game)|The Gunpowder Plot]]''. He has also played other non-Sontaran characters for audio and televised ''Doctor Who'' and ''The Sarah Jane Adventures''. He also made a cameo appearance in part-Sontaran costume in ''[[The Five(ish) Doctors Reboot (TV story)|The Five(ish) Doctors Reboot]]''.

He is best known for playing [[Strax]], an occasional associate of [[the Doctor]]'s. Besides appearing in episodes, Starkey also appears as Strax in a number of online promotional videos uploaded by the BBC under the title ''[[Strax Field Report]]'' and has also made public appearances in costume and in character as Strax at venues such as the [[Doctor Who Experience (London/Cardiff)|Doctor Who Experience]] and the 2013 edition of ''[[Doctor Who at the Proms (2013)|Doctor Who at the Proms]]''.

He has written several audio stories for [[Big Finish Productions]].

He was interviewed on [[THWR 35|the 35th edition]] of Big Finish's charitable podcast series ''[[Toby Hadoke's Who's Round]]'' and editions of the documentary series ''[[Doctor Who Confidential]]''.

== Career ==
Outside of ''Doctor Who'', starting from 2012, Starkey played the hobgoblin {{iw|wizardsvsaliens|Randal Moon}} in [[Russell T Davies]]' ''[[Wizards vs Aliens]]''.
